:::{#exm-variance-bernoulli}
#### Variance of a Bernoulli random variable

Let $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$.
Then $\E{X} = \prob$ and $\E{X^2} = \prob$
(both computed on the [expectation page](expectation.qmd#exm-lotus)), so:

$$
\ba
\Var{X}
&= \E{X^2} - \sqf{\E{X}}
&& \text{(simplified expression for variance)} \\
&= \prob - \prob^2
&& \text{(substitute)} \\
&= \prob(1 - \prob)
&& \text{(factor)}
\ea
$$

For a fair coin ($\prob = 1/2$), $\Var{X} = 1/4$.
@fig-bernoulli-variance graphs $\Var{X}$ against $\prob$.

:::
